title: Geopolitical Daily
email_subject: US and Iran talk through mediators
preheader: A seven-day plan includes frozen assets and an end to the oil blockade.
intro_text: Good morning. It's Tuesday, September 29, 2026 — the 3 stories that matter most today, plus 7 quick updates from around the world.

stories.story_title: US and Iran hold indirect talks to end seven-month war
stories.why_important: The US and Iran are talking through go-betweens about ending a seven-month war. Iran wants billions in frozen assets freed, oil sanctions ended, and the US port blockade lifted. A deal could calm oil markets. But the two sides remain far apart.
stories.what_overlooked: The talks are indirect. US midterm elections may make Washington unwilling to compromise before November.
stories.prediction: Watch whether mediators announce direct talks or another round within 72 hours.

stories.story_title: Ethiopia's peace deal collapses as fighting spreads in Tigray
stories.why_important: Ethiopia's military and rebel forces are fighting in Tigray, Amhara, and Afar. A four-year-old peace deal has collapsed. The government's large drone fleet gives it air power. This raises fears of a wider war in the Horn of Africa.
stories.what_overlooked: The 2022 peace deal ended one of Africa's deadliest wars. But its collapse has not drawn the same global attention.
stories.prediction: Watch whether federal forces push toward Mekelle or rebels open new fronts in Amhara.

stories.story_title: Estonia blames Russia for arson at defense company supplying Ukraine
stories.why_important: Estonia says Russia's security services ordered an arson attack on Milrem Robotics. The company supplies unmanned vehicles to Ukraine. NATO and EU allies are backing Estonia. The Kremlin denies involvement.
stories.what_overlooked: The attack happened in August. But Estonia's public accusation and NATO support are new. They raise pressure for a response.
stories.prediction: Watch whether NATO announces new measures to protect defense sites in member states.
